experience.faqTitle: A little clarity goes a long way.
experience.faqIntro: New to sourcing from China? We're here to make your first step a confident one.
experience.faq1Question: Can you help me find a product in China?
experience.faq1Answer: Yes. Share what you're looking for, your quantity, and any requirements. Our team can help identify suppliers, discuss pricing, and coordinate purchasing.
experience.faq2Question: Do you offer both air and sea shipping?
experience.faq2Answer: We coordinate both air and sea freight. The right option depends on your goods, shipment size, destination, and timing. Contact us to discuss a suitable route and quote.
experience.faq3Question: How do I get a quote?
experience.faq3Answer: Use the enquiry form below or message us on WhatsApp. Include product details, quantities, and your delivery location so our team can discuss the next steps with you.
experience.faq4Question: How can I install the A&A Shop app?
experience.faq4Answer: Get A&A Shop from Google Play on your Android phone. You can also visit our download page for a direct APK and installation instructions.

launch.faqLabel: A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER
launch.faqTitle: A little clarity, before you tap.
launch.faqBody: Getting started should feel easy. Here's what to know about A&A Shop.

faq1.question: What can I find on A&A Shop?
faq1.answer: Explore electronics, clothing, home appliances, beauty and care, toys and kids, and sports and outdoors. The homepage also features today's deals.

faq2.question: Is A&A Shop available for my phone?
faq2.answer: A&A Shop is available for Android. Visit the download page to get the app from Google Play or find the direct Android APK.

faq3.question: Can I get help with an order?
faq3.answer: Of course. Message the A&A team on WhatsApp with your order or product details. We're here to help with sourcing and shipping questions too.

faq4.question: Can A&A help source products for my business?
faq4.answer: Yes. We help with product sourcing, purchasing, quality checks, and logistics from China to Africa. Tell us what you're looking for using the contact form below.
